Container.Name: NexusBackup-Repository
Container.Overview: Nexus Backup TLS-authenticated Restic REST endpoint for workstation backups. It exposes only its dedicated repository storage and local transport credentials; it has no access to Nexus Control state, source data, restore staging or workstation Restic encryption passwords.
Container.Requires: Set Repository host to the LAN DNS name or IPv4 address that Windows workstations will use to reach this Unraid host. Install NexusBackup-Control too, and use exactly the same Repository public path in its template so Control can serve only the non-secret CA certificate to the workstation installer.

Config.Name: Repository config
Config.Description: Private TLS key, bcrypt htpasswd file and local workstation transport credentials. Treat this directory as secret.

Config.Name: Repository public
Config.Description: Non-secret generated CA certificate and endpoint metadata. Use this exact host path as /repository-public in NexusBackup-Control.

Config.Name: Workstation repository storage
Config.Description: Dedicated Restic repository data written directly by Windows workstations over the Nexus Repository TLS endpoint. Keep separate from PCWatch and generic Agent repositories.

Config.Name: Repository host
Config.Description: LAN DNS name or IPv4 address used by workstations, for example tower.local or 192.168.1.20. This value is embedded in the self-signed TLS certificate.

Config.Name: Repository port
Config.Description: TLS Restic REST port exposed on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Initial workstation user
Config.Description: Creates one initial private REST transport principal if it does not exist. Additional per-workstation users can be created from the container console with nexus-repository-client.
